Title: M.2 SSD REQUIREMENT FOR PS5
URL: https://webapi3.adata.com/storage/downloadfile/devicessup/PS5_Compatibility_ATOM_50_SSD.pdf
Published: N/A
Author: XPG
Highlights:
## M.2 SSD REQUIREMENT FOR PS5

### PlayStation 5 ATOM 50

CAPACITY 250GB – 4TB 512GB - 1TB

INTERFACE PCIe Gen4 x4 M.2 NVMe PCIe Gen4 x4 M.2 NVMe

SEQUENTIAL READ 5500MB/s or ABOVE

READ/WRITE 5,000/4,500MB/s (PC/laptop) READ 5,000MB/s (PS5)

SOCKET TYPE

SOCKET 3 (PCIe x4 & M KEY)

PCIe Gen4 x4, M KEY

M.2 SSD FORMAT SINGLE-SIDED / DOUBLE-SIDED SINGLE-SIDED

SLOT FORM FACTOR 2230/2242/2260/2280/22110 2280

LENGTH 30mm, 42mm, 60mm, 80mm, 110 mm 80mm

WIDTH < 25mm 22mm

HEIGHT < 11.25mm 3.13mm

COOLING STRUCTURE

EFFECTIVE HEAT DISSIPATION BUILT-IN HEATSINK / SELF-ATTACHING HEATSINK

PREINSTALLED HEATSINK

INSTALLATION SPACE < 110mm*25mm*11.25mm (L*W*H) < 80mm*22mm*3.13mm (L*W*H)

PS5 M.2 SSD SLOT VEW

## ATOM 50 PERFORMANCE TEST ON PS5

### ATOM 50

PERFORMANCE CHECK PASS 1

BOOT GAME CHECK PASS 2

THERMAL CHECK PASS 3

IDENTIFY CHECK PASS 4

FORMAT CHECK PASS 5

MIGRATION DATA CHECK PASS 6

1,2 
PERFORMANCE MAY VARY ACCORDING TO DIFFERENT USAGE ENVIRONMENTS. 
3 
TEMPERATURE MAY VARY ACCORDING TO DIFFERENT USAGE ENVIRONMENTS. 

FORMAT CHECK

IDENTIFY CHECK

MIGRATION CHECK
